title: The Rain, private
logline: The twenty-fifth January. The garage sill, rain, three jars, the pup in the bed, the lamp on. The public strip's Rain, kept going for nobody.

panels.composition: The casement window in rain from inside, the three jars, the lamp's warm circle on the table with a page on it — this page, half drawn — and the pup in the bed beneath, awake, watching the rain. Twenty-five Januaries. No one to show.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage studio window in January rain seen from inside with three jars on the sill, a lamp's warm circle on a drafting table where a half-finished drawing lies, a small three-legged dog awake in a braided bed beneath watching the rain, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The Rain continues privately. The page drawing itself.
